rule: A50; every set independently measured; >3% rework -> full affected set read; no dispositions changed by sampling

preserve-pending-target.mandatoryDeepRead: Deep-read every row, including actual consumer and target/IO context.

preserve-pending-behavioral-proof.mandatoryDeepRead: Deep-read every row, including actual consumer and target/IO context.

mechanical-target-failures.mandatoryDeepRead: Deep-read every failed target passage against the consumer claim; word matches are not semantic proof.

anchor-check-failures.mandatoryDeepRead: All effective slice-1/2 failures, including unresolved owners/fragments. Re-review with additive corrections; no blanket pass.

writers-and-writer-triage.mandatoryDeepRead: Trace every possible writer to a real destination/open/default-root and paired checks; lexical wording is triage, not proof.

behavioral-runtime-and-contract-triage.mandatoryDeepRead: Deep-read every operational/read/default-root/data row, including conserved carriers; confirm adoption/retired-engine status and exact current call sites before rewrite.

wrapped-new-edges.mandatoryDeepRead: Every new physical joined citation: verify every line/span, owner and semantic role; missing targets stay blocked.

wrapped-rebindings.mandatoryDeepRead: Every corrected truncated owner, including skills-182/183 and maps-01758; no inherited approval.

literal-new-edges.mandatoryDeepRead: All AGENTS omissions, citation-format globs, non-authority backfill edges; trace writer versus reader.

slice2-corrections.mandatoryDeepRead: Every L12-20 effective correction; compare superseded row and exact source, target, blocked patches and meaning changes.

native-dynamic-patterns.mandatoryDeepRead: All unresolved dynamic patterns; concrete source/open/write trace still required. Not covered by navigation mapping review.

overlap: Sets overlap intentionally. Count/rate per set, never sum as unique edges. Writers/runtime sets retain lexical triage in conserved/source carriers.
class3StillOpen: 13,136 native reconciliation rows remain available in old artifacts. This recut does not certify old coordinates as current, resolve dynamic/adoption/parity gaps, or grant rewrite readiness. Original source table, all native edges and ledger join are retained.
